changelog.summary: Adds a chat-led onboarding-to-adoption proposal with validated first-value evidence and an optional account health review.

title: New Customer to First Value
description: Coordinate onboarding milestones and observed product adoption so a new B2B customer reaches an agreed first result.
setup_prompt: Use New Customer to First Value as a proposal. Inspect existing Crews, the signed sales handoff, onboarding tracker, product event source, support scope, customer owner, and actual first-value definition. Propose which Crews to reuse or create, an owned milestone plan, validated onboarding-to-adoption handoff, optional health review, dashboard, and bounded manual first run. After I review the concrete proposal, configure it through Builder tools and verify it. Selecting this Playbook alone does not create Crews, connect accounts, message customers, update CRM, or enable recurrence.

setup_inputs.label: Authorized new-customer account and signed handoff or export
Agreed first-value result, observable event, and target date
Onboarding owner and customer contact policy
Onboarding milestones and current status source
Product usage or setup event source and coverage
Manual-only or reviewed monitoring cadence and timezone

recommended_tools.name: Builder create_crew
recommended_tools.purpose: Create a reviewed missing Customer Success specialist with a stable idempotency key

recommended_tools.name: Builder manage_crew_attachment
recommended_tools.purpose: Pass only a validated bounded account artifact between authorized Crews

recommended_tools.name: CRM or signed handoff export
recommended_tools.purpose: Read the customer identity, purchased scope, owner, and promised result

recommended_tools.name: Product analytics or bounded event export
recommended_tools.purpose: Verify the agreed first-value event and source coverage

recommended_tools.name: Support inbox or case export
recommended_tools.purpose: Ground an optional account health review in current open issues

pulse_focus.label: Customer first-value progress
focus_areas: Whether new customers reach the agreed first result by the target date
Whether stalled onboarding is detected with enough evidence for an owner action
review_when: A milestone slips, first-value evidence arrives, source coverage changes, or an owner action remains open

outputs: Reviewed Customer Success Crew roster and source map
